mapper.sql: id, username, username_key, nickname, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at, version, deleted_at, security_version, credential_version, login_name_version, password_changed_at, current_zone_period_id, pending_zone_id, pending_zone_effective_at, pending_zone_requested_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app.app_user WHERE pending_zone_effective_at <= clock_timestamp() AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY pending_zone_effective_at, id LIMIT 100
SELECT id, user_id, revision, zone_id, tzdb_version, valid_from, valid_to, source FROM app.user_zone_period WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.user_zone_period (id, user_id, revision, zone_id, tzdb_version, valid_from, source) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{revision}, #{zoneId}, #{tzdbVersion}, #{validFrom}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.user_zone_period SET valid_to = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND valid_to IS NULL

UPDATE app.app_user SET current_zone_period_id = #{periodId}, pending_zone_id = NULL, pending_zone_effective_at = NULL, pending_zone_requested_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{userId}

UPDATE app.app_user SET pending_zone_id = #{zoneId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pending_zone_effective_at = #{effectiveAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, pending_zone_requested_at = CASE WHEN #{zoneId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() END, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{userId}
